results.title: Orchards, sisters and   inheritance: reading The Glass Orchard
results.author: Rowan Pell
results.text: Mira Calloway's second novel follows three sisters who inherit a failing orchard in a valley that is slowly drying out. The book is less about farming than about what each sister believes she owes the others, and the essay traces how the orchard becomes a ledger of debts that no one agreed to keep. It closes with a look at the novel's divisive ending and why it works.
